tools.name: list_latest_articles
tools.title: List latest articles
tools.description: List the most recently published Amaica Media articles, optionally filtered by category or region. Returns a strict typed array of {id, headline, lede, byline, category, region, status, hero_image_url, published_at, word_count, source_count, is_legend}.

tools.name: search_articles
tools.title: Search articles
tools.description: Full-text search of published Amaica Media articles across headline, lede, and body. Supports quoted "exact phrases", basic English stemming (plurals, -ing, -ed), region scoping ('western_kenya' | 'kenya' | 'national' | 'all'), category filter, published_at date window (start_date / end_date, ISO 8601), and pagination via limit + offset. Returns strict typed {results, count, total, limit, offset, has_more} with each result {id, headline, lede, byline, category, region, status, hero_image_url, published_at, word_count, source_count, is_legend, match_score}.

query.description: Keywords to search for across headline, lede, and body. Wrap exact phrases in double quotes (e.g. `"nyanza festival" bongo`). Bare tokens are also matched by simple stems (plurals, -ing, -ed).

region_scope.description: Scope results by region. 'western_kenya' restricts to region='western_kenya' OR body/headline mentioning a Western Kenya county/town. 'kenya' includes both national and western_kenya rows. 'national' restricts to region='national'. 'all' returns everything.

start_date.description: Only include articles with published_at >= this ISO 8601 timestamp.

end_date.description: Only include articles with published_at <= this ISO 8601 timestamp.

offset.description: Number of results to skip for pagination.

tools.name: get_article
tools.title: Get article
tools.description: Fetch a published Amaica Media article by id. Returns a strict typed payload with headline, lede, body, byline, category, region, status, published_at, hero_image_url, word_count, sources (array of {url,title?,note?,section?}), and legend info when the article is an Our Legends feature.

tools.name: list_legends
tools.title: List legends
tools.description: List African entertainment legends in the Amaica 'Our Legends' roster.
